sites.name: Eastgate Chemical Works
hazards: Chlorine store (2 x 1 tonne drums), north yard
sites.tactics: Approach from the south (upwind in prevailing wind). Do not use water on building C store. Meet the site emergency team at the gatehouse. Consider Hazmat officer and DIM on all turnouts.
water: Private hydrant ring main, 150 mm, around buildings A-D
Open water: canal, 200 m east (pump access via Lock Lane)

sites.name: Grange Tower
sites.tactics: Dry riser inlet on the west face. Fire-fighting lift serves all floors. Premises information box at the main entrance.
water: Hydrant nearest the dry riser inlet, about 30 m
